note: Evaluation-only answer key. Read by scripts/eval_report.py; never passed to runtime agents or prompts.

reference_states.name: Schedule rejected with validation alert
reference_states.heading: Schedule a post
reference_states.why_optional: on the broken build a past date is accepted; the alert state needs another invalid input

known_defects.description: A publish date before the studio date is accepted and a post is scheduled.

ambiguous.description: Whether an empty title or caption must be rejected is not stated; a confirmation is a false confirmation.
Scheduling with an empty post title is not covered by an explicit rejection requirement.

scoring.defect_found: a confirmed finding citing the defect's requirement whose inputs put the field before the cut-off date
scoring.false_confirmation: any confirmed finding that does not match a known defect of that build
scoring.zero_findings: never counted as a pass; reported with coverage and unfinished work
